suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Wash and fold
suggested_services.example: The main story: 20 pounds of wash and fold, $35. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off. Dolores weighs and tags it, texts READY, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Special-care items
suggested_services.example: A silk dress and a suede jacket, priced at the counter before any cleaning. Nothing is taken. Alex says yes to the price, and pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Wedding gown cleaning
suggested_services.example: A wedding gown cleaning, $140. A $40 deposit books the slot, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Wash and fold pickup
suggested_services.example: The main story: a pickup of 20 pounds of wash and fold, $35. A card is saved, with no fee. Mateo picks up the bags at the door, and the card is charged the ticket total when the order is delivered.

suggested_services.name: Wash and fold pickup
suggested_services.example: A salon's towels, picked up and delivered on account. Nothing is taken when it books, and Rosie texts the bill after the delivery.

services_listed_in_profession_file.price: $1.75 a pound, 10-pound minimum ($17.50); the example order of 20 pounds is $35

services_listed_in_profession_file.after: paid at the counter at pick-up; for a pickup, the saved card is charged when the order is delivered

before_times: Drop-off at the counter, or pickup at the door
Wash and fold, dry cleaning, comforters or blankets, or a mix
About how many pounds or items
The date it's needed back, like an event (it sets which turnaround fits)
For a pickup: the town and the kind of place, a house or an apartment with a doorman
Any item soaked in gasoline, oil or thinner, with blood, or holding needles or sharp things: those stay out of the bag
after_time: Detergent: regular, fragrance-free or hypoallergenic; fabric softener or not
Folded or on hangers; starch on shirts
Any stain the customer knows about: what and where
Items that need special care, like silk, wool or leather
secure_page_only: The street address, the door or doorman instructions and any building code
A skin or allergy reason for fragrance-free (the preference itself isn't private)
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or their household; a parent books for a child's clothes

safety_and_stop_words.go_on: yes, for the rest of the order, after the item is set aside
safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: no danger words of its own: the generic screen (danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency, crisis words) is always on

prep: Bag your laundry and empty the pockets
List any stains on the secure page
For a pickup: leave the bags at the door by the start of the window
first_steps_and_forms.required: none for a drop-off; for a pickup: the door instructions on the secure page

staff.licenses_or_certificates: none for a person; drivers hold a valid driver's license, and the business's auto insurance covers them
staff.supervision: solvents are handled only by trained staff, under the shop's safety rules
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs claims, refunds and special-item prices over $100
staff.stand_in: any driver on the route may do a pickup; any counter staff may take a drop-off; nobody is booked by name

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or their household; a parent books for a child's clothes
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a child's clothes go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: at the counter: the check-in code, or a walk-in checked in at once; at the door: the driver scans the bag tag and takes a photo of the bags, and nobody needs to be home
visit.done: DONE at pick-up at the counter, or at delivery with the door photo
visit.changes_at_visit: a repair, extra stain work or special cleaning found later is priced first and needs the customer's yes; no answer in 24 hours: cleaned the normal way, without the extra

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none for laundry, wash and fold or dry cleaning in most places; the business registration, where the state asks for one; a dry cleaner that uses cleaning solvents holds the environmental registration or permit the state's rules require (solvent use and waste)
license.who: the business; no license for a person
ask: The business registration number, where the state gave one
For dry cleaning with solvents: the environmental registration or permit number, where the state's rules require one
Proof of business auto insurance, for pickup and delivery
license.insurance: liability insurance and cover for customers' garments while the shop has them, as the business says; shown only once proof is sent

never_in_a_text: A skin or allergy reason for fragrance-free
